atoms.b: When I first came to New York, I was so ((++thrilled frustrated)) to see all the sights and try the American food. I am still ((++amazed annoyed)) by all the great things you can do in the city. However, sometimes life in the Big Apple can be ((++lonely relieved)), because with so many people you might feel ((++isolated thrilled)). Nevertheless, if I feel ((++sad hopeful)), I just call my family, and they cheer me up. Also, they are always ((++delighted unhappy)) when I call them.

I love going to Central Park. Sitting on a blanket in the green always makes me feel ((++relaxed anxious)). Especially in summer you can do ((++amazing confusing)) activities. Every Sunday, I am ((++excited worried)) to go there with friends because you can meet so many interesting people. Still, I would never go there in the dark because that's ((++frightening proud)).

On Friday, we visited the Empire State Building for the first time. Expectant of what we will see, we went up the huge building. I was so ((++annoyed confident)) by all the stairs we had to walk because my mother wanted the real experience. After 30 minutes of stair walking we were so ((++miserable relaxed)) that we decided to take the lift. When we finally reached the viewing platform, we were ((++thrilled hopeful)) by the great view. I am ((++fortunate uncomfortable)) to have experienced this.
